name: Blue Manila
description: Planasa blueberry cultivar from the selection 'Plablue 1545', protected in the United States by US PP31,345 and the subject of a CPVO application filed in August 2018. Its published performance figures come from Planasa's own trial plots in Morocco and Spain and are marked as non-contractual by the owner; two Planasa pages give different soluble solids figures for the same cultivar.

traits.value: 19,000 kg/ha in years 1 and 2; 23,000 kg/ha in year 3
traits.conditions: Stated by the owner as average results from Planasa trial plots in Morocco and Spain, obtained under specific and controlled conditions and marked NOT CONTRACTUAL. No season, replication or plot design is given.
